title: Technical Architect
jobDescription: We are seeking a highly experienced Solution Architect / Technical Architect to lead the design and evolution of our Defense and Data Analytics platforms . This role is responsible for converting complex operational and analytical requirements into secure, scalable, and high-performance system architectures . The ideal candidate will own both solution-level architecture (business alignment, system design, technology choices) and technical-level architecture (backend systems, data models, performance, reliability). Strong expertise in Python-based backend development , Neo4j graph databases , and Elasticsearch is essential, along with experience in distributed and cloud-native systems. This position requires strong technical leadership, architectural decision-making, and close collaboration with Product, Data, and Engineering teams in a high-reliability, security-conscious environment.

title: Technical Project Manager
jobDescription: We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Senior Project Manager with over 12 years of proven track record in AI/ML and Data Analytics product line. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing large-scale government projects, along with a deep understanding of AI/ML technologies and data analytics methodologies. The role requires hands-on experience in objection handling, team management, and a strong ability to drive project delivery within defined timelines and budgets.
